annotation.title_clean: AI Readiness through Implementation of the EU AI Act in Slovenian Public Administration
annotation.title_en: AI Readiness through Implementation of the EU AI Act in Slovenian Public Administration
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Kovač, P.; Babšek, M.; Aristovnik, A.
annotation.venue: NISPAcee Conference 2025, Bratislava, WG9 Law and Public Administration
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper analysing how Slovenian public administration authorities understand and prepare to implement the EU AI Act, combining legal doctrinal analysis with surveys and focus groups. Finds divergent views on the Act's binding nature, fragmented oversight and delayed implementation, and calls for coordination, capacity building and operational guidelines.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ministries recognise the AI Act as binding, but many implementing authorities treat it as a strategic guideline.
Some authorities misunderstand the Act's direct applicability as an EU regulation.
Stakeholders disagree on centralised versus decentralised national AI governance.
Slovenia's draft Implementation Act designates competent authorities, a contact point and sandboxes.
Recommends systemic coordination, targeted capacity building and clear operational guidelines.
